The '''Mandel family mansion''' was the home of [[Kvarn Mandel]] and his family, including wife [[Emlyn Mandel|Emlyn]], and children [[Samire Mandel|Samire]] and [[Simmin Mandel|Simmin]]. It was located in the underground [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fabrin (city)|Fabrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]].
